mechanism: Zoledronic acid can cause renal impairment and electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that may increase oxycodone sensitivity and CNS depression risk, while oxycodone-induced constipation may be exacerbated by zoledronic acid's GI effects.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and oxycodone efficacy/toxicity; ensure adequate hydration with zoledronic acid infusion; manage constipation prophylactically; adjust oxycodone dosing if renal function declines.
